spans.text: SynthNet is a small convolutional model trained on the Widget benchmark.
We evaluate SynthNet using the Standard Evaluation Procedure with batch size 32.
The learning rate configuration was set to 0.001 for all training runs.
SynthNet substantially outperforms the Baseline on Widget accuracy.
We further claim SynthNet generalizes to unseen domains, though no cross-domain experiment is reported in this paper.
